modelName: GOLD CUP TROPHY 9MM ELITE POLISHED SS GOLD
modelDescription: Colt Gold Cup Trophy- A Masterpiece of Elegance and Precision - A stunning expression of Colt’s legendary heritage this Colt Gold Cup Trophy combines timeless craftsmanship with an unmistakable touch of luxury. - The beautifully executed high-polished flats provide a brilliant mirror-like finish elegantly accented by precision-applied 24kt gold borders that gracefully follow the contours of the slide. Colt’s iconic Rampant Pony rendered in 24kt gold further celebrates the rich tradition and distinguished legacy of this American classic. - Complementing the striking presentation high-polished TiN pvd gold-finished small parts provide a sophisticated contrast against the brilliant stainless steel with excellent durability. The distinctive blue textured grips add a bold splash of color bringing balance and character to this exceptional firearm. - Every detail has been thoughtfully considered transforming an already prestigious competition pistol into an extraordinary statement of artistry. - An elegant marriage of performance tradition and luxury this Colt Gold Cup Trophy is a true testament to the art of fine firearm embellishment by Baron Engraving. - FRAME- HIGH POLISH FLATS (REDRESS RADIUS) - SLIDE- HIGH POLISH FLATS (REDRESS RADIUS) - SMALL PARTS HIGH POLISHED - HAMMER GRIP SAFETY THUMB SAFETY SLIDE STOP BARREL BUSHING MAG CATCH AND LOCK GRIP SCREWS(4) - 24 KT GOLD PLATING - HAMMER GRIP SAFETY THUMB SAFETY SLIDE STOP BARREL BUSHING MAG CATCH AND LOCK GRIP SCREWS(4) - DEEP LASER ENGRAVING/ 2 SIDES BORDER WITH RAMPANT COLTS BEHIND REAR SERRATION - SELECTIVE 24 KT GOLD PLATED BORDER AND RAMPANT HORSES
